description: This PHP source file defines the EmailSubscriberAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements CRUD endpoints for managing email subscribers associated with email notification subscriptions in the HRM system, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting email subscriber records with appropriate validation rules and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberAPI
classes.description: A REST API class providing CRUD operations for Email Subscribers related to email notifications, with extensive validation, documentation annotations, and integration with the OrangeHRM core services.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of email subscribers associated with a specific email subscription ID, with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new email subscriber entry linked to a specified email subscription.

methods.name: setParamsToEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Populates an EmailSubscriber entity with parameters from the request, including subscription, name, and email.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving email subscribers, including subscription ID and sorting/pagination rules.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more email subscribers based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting email subscribers, including IDs and subscription ID validation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single email subscriber record by its ID and associated subscription ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single email subscriber, including ID and subscription ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing email subscriber record with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an email subscriber.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for request body parameters common to create and update operations, including email format and uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Configures uniqueness validation options for email subscription email addresses.
